name: Ookami to Koushinryou - Boku to Holo no Ichinen
original_name: 狼と香辛料 ボクとホロの一年
source:
The player assumes the role of an unnamed young man as he travels around with Holo for a period of one year in the game. The story differs from that of the original novels or anime and is presented as an additional Spice and Wolf world.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spice_and_Wolf]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演一名无名青年，在游戏中与赫萝共同旅行1年。故事不同于原作小说或动画，以《狼与香辛料》世界的附加篇章形式呈现。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spice_and_Wolf]Wikipedia[/url]]
